peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0. It checks that boomlet_0_identity_pubkey exists in the set of peer_ids_collection. Non-initiator Niso checks
that the withdrawal_id values match, peer_0_tx_approval is fresh according to wt_tx_approval, and wt_tx_approval is fresh according to most_work_bitcoin_block_height.

It then checks that most_work_bitcoin_block_height has passed milestone_block_0 from boomerang_descriptor and forwards the received message alongside niso_1_event_block_height to Non-initiator Boomlet.
niso_1_event_block_height} from Non-initiator Niso. Non-initiator Boomlet verifies wt_pubkey's signature on wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt and verifies
boomlet_0_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0. It verifies that boomlet_0_identity_pubkey exists in the set of peer_ids_collection,
decrypts psbt_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_boomlet_1 using boomlet_1_identity_privkey and boomlet_0_identity, and reconstructs withdrawal_id from setup_instance_id,
psbt.derive_tx_id(), boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, and peer_0_tx_approval.approval_nonce. Non-initiator Boomlet checks that the reconstructed withdrawal_id matches
peer_0_tx_approval and wt_tx_approval, that both approvals are fresh, and that milestone_block_0 has passed. Non-initiator Boomlet then sends psbt to non-initiator Niso.

psbt := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_psbt", withdrawal_id), envelope: psbt_encrypted_by_boomlet_0_for_boomlet_1)
expected_withdrawal_id := tagged_sha256("Boomerang/withdrawal_id", canonical_encode(setup_instance_id, psbt.derive_tx_id(), boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, peer_0_tx_approval.approval_nonce))
Non-initiator Niso receives psbt from Non-initiator Boomlet. Non-initiator Niso checks that psbt is satisfiable and that the derived tx_id
reconstructs peer_0_tx_approval.withdrawal_id under the active setup. It then outputs psbt along with initiator's peer_i_id to non-initiator User.

Assert tagged_sha256("Boomerang/withdrawal_id", canonical_encode(setup_instance_id, psbt.derive_tx_id(), boomlet_0_identity_pubkey, peer_0_tx_approval.approval_nonce)) == peer_0_tx_approval.withdrawal_id
Non-initiator User receives {psbt, initiator_peer_id} from non-initiator Niso. Non-initiator User then informs non-initiator Niso of its agreement

then informs non-initiator Boomlet to proceed.

Non-initiator Niso receives tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st from non-initiator Boomlet and forwards it to non-initiator ST.
Non-initiator ST receives tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st from non-initiator Niso. Non-initiator ST decrypts
tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st to get tx_id_with_nonce and outputs the content of it i.e. tx_id to non-initiator User.

tx_id_with_nonce := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_1_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review"), envelope: tx_id_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st)
Non-initiator User receives tx_id from non-initiator ST. Non-initiator User checks to see tx_id matches the one he previously received from
non-initiator Niso and agreed to. It then informs non-initiator ST of his agreement.
from non-initiator User. It signs the tx_id_with_nonce, encrypts it with boomlet_1_identity_pubkey and sends the result to non-initiator Niso.

tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_1 := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_1_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: st_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review_approval"), content: tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st)
Non-initiator Niso receives tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_1 from non-initiator ST. Non-initiator Niso forwards
tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_1 along with the updated niso_1_event_block_height to non-initiator Boomlet.
Non-initiator Boomlet receives {tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_1, niso_1_event_block_height} from non-initiator Niso.

tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_1_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: st_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_review_approval"), envelope: tx_id_with_nonce_signed_by_st_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_1)

_peer_1_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", wt_pubkey, "wt", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id), content: _peer_1_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_1)
Non-initiator Niso receives {withdrawal_id, peer_1_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt} from non-initiator Boomlet and forwards them to WT.

WT receives {withdrawal_id, peer_1_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt} from non-initiator Niso, decrypts it using canonical context {"withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id},

verifies boomlet_1_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_1_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_1, checks that withdrawal_id matches the expected value, and checks that the message is fresh according to the most_work_bitcoin_block_height and event_block_height of wt_tx_approval.
It also receives withdrawal_id with peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i_encrypted_by_boomlet_i_for_wt from non-initiator Peers and repeats the same validation process.

WT sorts the valid approvals into ordered_peer_tx_approvals in active setup peer order and derives ordered_non_initiator_peer_tx_approvals := ordered_peer_tx_approvals with the initiator approval omitted. WT then sends ordered_non_initiator_peer_tx_approvals to each non-initiator peer and
in a separate message sends ordered_peer_tx_approvals along with wt_tx_approval to the initiator peer.

peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(wt_privkey, "wt", peer_ids_collection[i].boomlet_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: peer_ids_collection[i].boomlet_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_approval", withdrawal_id), envelope: peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i_encrypted_by_boomlet_i_for_wt) [2 <= i <= 4]
ordered_peer_tx_approvals := Collection<peer_i_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_i> [0 <= i <= 4] sorted in active setup peer order by peer_ids_collection
ordered_non_initiator_peer_tx_approvals := ordered_peer_tx_approvals with the initiator approval omitted

It verifies the subset is ordered by peer_ids_collection with the initiator omitted, reconstructs ordered_peer_tx_approvals by inserting the stored initiator approval at the initiator active setup peer position, and computes approved_withdrawal_id from the complete ordered set for local tracking. It forwards ordered_non_initiator_peer_tx_approvals alongside niso_1_event_block_height to non-initiator Boomlet.
ordered_peer_tx_approvals := insert stored peer_0_tx_approval_signed_by_boomlet_0 into ordered_non_initiator_peer_tx_approvals at initiator_peer_id active setup peer position

Niso. After renewing niso_1_event_block_height, for every peer in peer_ids_collection except the initiator, non-initiator Boomlet verifies boomlet_i_identity_pubkey's

It verifies the subset is ordered by peer_ids_collection with the initiator omitted, reconstructs ordered_peer_tx_approvals by inserting the stored initiator approval at the initiator active setup peer position, and computes approved_withdrawal_id from withdrawal_id and the complete ordered set. It then generates duress_check_space
as one randomly sorted list of integers from 1 to 193, including all elements of 1..193, adds a nonce to it and encrypts it. Then non-initiator Boomlet sends

duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_1_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_challenge"), content: duress_check_space_with_nonce)
Non-initiator Niso receives duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st from non-initiator Boomlet and forwards it to non-initiator ST.
Non-initiator ST receives duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st from non-initiator Niso, decrypts it to get

duress_check_space_with_nonce, maps each integer in duress_check_space through DURESS_DISPLAY_VOCABULARY, creates 5 independently shuffled display columns from the single received list, and keeps display-to-original-index mappings locally.

duress_check_space_with_nonce := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(st_1_identity_privkey, "st", boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: st_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_challenge"), envelope: duress_check_space_with_nonce_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_st)

Non-initiator ST receives the displayed selections from non-initiator User, converts them into indices in Boomlet's original single list, then creates

Assert each user_selection value exists in its corresponding duress_display_columns column

rejects no outstanding duress check, wrong phase, duplicate response, wrong nonce, wrong count, duplicate indices, or out-of-range indices. from ordered_peer_tx_approvals and wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt after verifying that content, proving it accepted the same approved withdrawal before commit processing, signs the fingerprint with boomlet_1_identity_privkey and sends it to

duress_signal_index_with_nonce := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", st_1_identity_pubkey, "st", sender_public_key: st_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_response"), envelope: duress_signal_index_with_nonce_encrypted_by_st_for_boomlet_1)
Assert outstanding duress check exists for current phase
duress_placeholder_plaintext := Evaluate(duress_signal, duress_consent_set, doxing_key_for_sar) [either all-zero 32-byte padding or doxing_key_for_sar]

duress_placeholder := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", sar_pubkey, "sar", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: sar_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_placeholder", approved_withdrawal_id), content: duress_placeholder_plaintext)
Non-initiator Niso receives approval_set_attestation_fingerprint_signed_by_boomlet_1 from non-initiator Boomlet and forwards it to WT.
WT receives approval_set_attestation_fingerprint_signed_by_boomlet_1 from non-initiator Niso. WT recomputes approval_set_attestation_fingerprint from the accepted

ordered_peer_tx_approvals and wt_tx_approval_signed_by_wt, verifies boomlet_1_identity_pubkey's signature, and checks the signed content to equal the recomputed fingerprint. This proves non-initiator Boomlet accepted the same approved withdrawal before commit processing. At the same time it receives

approval_set_attestation_fingerprint_signed_by_boomlet_i [2 <= i <= 4], verifies exactly one approval-set attestation from each non-initiator Boomlet, and rejects duplicate, missing, wrong-signer, or wrong-fingerprint attestations before advancing to commit processing.
Assert approval_set_attestations contains exactly one approval_set_attestation_fingerprint_signed_by_boomlet_i for each peer_ids_collection[i].boomlet_identity_pubkey [1 <= i <= 4]
Assert approval_set_attestations has no duplicate signers and no missing non-initiator signers
Non-initiator Niso receives peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_signed_by_wt from WT. Non-initiator Niso updates niso_1_event_block_height
with the most_work_bitcoin_block_height, verifies wt_pubkey's signature on peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_signed_by_wt,
boomlet_0_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0, approved_withdrawal_id to be the expected value, and
event_block_height to be fresh according to most_work_bitcoin_block_height. Non-initiator Niso then forwards
Non-initiator Boomlet receives {peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_signed_by_wt, niso_1_event_block_height} from non-initiator Niso.
Non-initiator Boomlet verifies wt_pubkey's signature on peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0_signed_by_wt, boomlet_0_identity_pubkey's
signature on peer_0_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_0, approved_withdrawal_id to be the expected value, and event_block_height to be fresh according to niso_1_event_block_height.

Non-initiator Boomlet then generates peer_1_tx_commit containing approved_withdrawal_id and event_block_height, signs it with boomlet_1_identity_privkey, pads it with duress_placeholder, signs it again and encrypts it with
wt_pubkey. It then sends peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt to Niso.

_peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(boomlet_1_identity_privkey, "boomlet", wt_pubkey, "wt", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_commit", approved_withdrawal_id), content: _peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1)
Non-initiator Niso receives peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt from non-initiator Boomlet and forwards it to WT.
WT receives peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt from non-initiator Niso, decrypts it
with wt_privkey, verifies boomlet_1_identity_pubkey's signature. It then derives duress_placeholder by separating the padding from
peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded and sends it to SAR. It also saves peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1 for later.

peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1 := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(wt_privkey, "wt", boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: wt_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_tx_commit", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1_padded_signed_by_boomlet_1_encrypted_by_boomlet_1_for_wt)
SAR receives {duress_placeholder, boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, approved_withdrawal_id} from WT. It decrypts duress_placeholder using the Boomlet-to-SAR CBC/CMAC envelope context and
sar_privkey to get duress_placeholder_plaintext. It classifies the plaintext as valid safe if it is all-zero 32-byte padding, valid duress if its derived doxing_data_identifier exists,
or malformed otherwise. If it was valid duress and the tuple of approved_withdrawal_id, the received boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, and envelope IV of duress_placeholder was not previously saved, it uses
duress_placeholder_plaintext which is equal to doxing_key_for_sar to decrypt the associated static_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar and

dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar. It then uses this doxing_data to enter SEARCH AND RESCUE. For valid safe or duress placeholders, SAR signs duress_placeholder with sar_privkey and encrypts it with
boomlet_1_identity_pubkey. Malformed placeholders are rejected before any acknowledgment is created.

duress_placeholder_plaintext := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: channel_keys(sar_privkey, "sar", boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, receiver_public_key: sar_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_duress_placeholder", approved_withdrawal_id), envelope: duress_placeholder)
[SEARCH AND RESCUE [is_valid_duress_placeholder and (approved_withdrawal_id, boomlet_identity_pubkey, duress_placeholder.iv) not previously saved]]

static_doxing_data := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: derive_cbc_cmac_keys(doxing_key_for_sar, "Boomerang/sar_stored_data"), context: canonical_encode("sar_static_data", doxing_data_identifier), envelope: static_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar)

dynamic_doxing_data := cbc_cmac_decrypt(keys: derive_cbc_cmac_keys(doxing_key_for_sar, "Boomerang/sar_stored_data"), context: canonical_encode("sar_dynamic_data", doxing_data_identifier), envelope: dynamic_doxing_data_encrypted_by_doxing_key_for_sar)

duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_1 := cbc_cmac_encrypt(keys: channel_keys(sar_privkey, "sar", boomlet_1_identity_pubkey, "boomlet", sender_public_key: sar_pubkey, receiver_public_key: boomlet_1_identity_pubkey), context: canonical_encode("withdrawal_sar_placeholder_response", approved_withdrawal_id), content: duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar)
WT receives duress_placeholder_signed_by_sar_encrypted_by_sar_for_boomlet_1 from SAR and continues processing peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1.
It verifies boomlet_1_identity_pubkey's signature on peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1, checks approved_withdrawal_id to be the one
expected and event_block_height to be fresh. WT then signs peer_1_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_1 with wt_privkey. WT then sends the
collection of peer_i_tx_commit_signed_by_boomlet_i_signed_by_wt [0 <= i <= 4] to Each Niso alongside its respective
From this point on, non-initiator follows the same steps as initiator. (Withdrawal Diagram)
